name: Bernardus Lodge & Spa
positioning: Carmel Valley lodge set among its own vineyards and rose gardens, with fireplace suites and a garden-to-treatment spa
best_for: Couples wanting a suite with a fireplace and a soaking tub for two

facts.text: The hotel is at 415 W Carmel Valley Road in Carmel Valley, California.
The main house is decorated with copper chandeliers.
Besides the main house, the property has nine Monterey Territorial-style adobe guesthouses.
Each suite has a stone fireplace.
Suites come with complimentary in-room wine.
The spa experience is inspired by the natural Carmel Valley surroundings.
The spa's menu caters to individuals, couples and groups.
Lucia Restaurant & Bar serves regional cuisine.

highlights.text: The property has eight acres of wine vineyards.
Each suite has a two-person deep soaking tub.
The Spa at Bernardus follows a garden-to-treatment philosophy.
Suites have French doors that open onto private decks.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the secluded inland location means a car is needed to reach the coast and Carmel village.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that may not suit all budgets.
Spa reservations are made through the Spa Concierge.
